documents.text: --- Page 1 --- AI Engineer Roadmap 1 ⃣ What does an AI Engineer actually do? An AI Engineer is not just a “model trainer”. They mainly: ● Use existing AI models (OpenAI, LLMs, ML models) ● Build real features using AI ● Integrate AI into apps, APIs, products ● Optimize, deploy, and maintain AI systems Think of it like this: AI Researcher → creates models AI Engineer → uses models to build products ✅ You are already very close to this role. 2 ⃣ Skills you already have (Huge Advantage 💪 ) You already know: Your Skill How it Helps in AI Engineering JavaScript / PHP AI APIs, prompt logic, workflows Laravel APIs AI microservices React / Next.js AI-powered UI (chat, summaries, dashboards) REST APIs Model integration DB & SQL Vector DB + AI storage Healthcare domain AI use cases (coding, summaries, prediction) --- Page 2 --- 👉 You don’t need hardcore math or deep ML initially 3 ⃣ AI Engineer Learning Roadmap (Practical Path) 🔹 Phase 1: AI Foundations (2–3 weeks) You only need conceptual clarity , not PhD math. Learn: ● What is AI vs ML vs DL ● What are LLMs ● What is prompt engineering ● Tokens, embeddings, context window ✅ Focus: Understanding, not memorizing 🔹 Phase 2: Python for AI (Lightweight) 🐍 You don’t need advanced Python. Learn only: ● Python basics ● Virtual environments ● requests , json ● Basic data handling 💡 You’ll mostly use Python for: ● Model calls ● AI scripts ● Pipelines 🔹 Phase 3: Core AI Engineer Skills ⭐ (MOST IMPORTANT) This is where you become an AI Engineer . 🔹 1. LLM APIs --- Page 3 --- Learn how to use: ● OpenAI / Azure OpenAI ● Prompt templates ● System vs user prompts ● Function calling Example: Summarize patient notes Generate medical codes Explain diagnosis in simple terms 🔹 2. Prompt Engineering (Critical Skill) You must learn: ● Zero-shot / Few-shot prompts ● Role-based prompts ● Chain-of-thought (controlled) ● Output formatting (JSON) 👉 This is more valuable than ML math 🔹 3. RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) Very important for real apps. Learn: ● Embeddings ● Vector databases ● Document search ● Context injection Use cases: ● PDF analysis ● EHR documents ● Internal knowledge base ● Policies & SOPs --- Page 4 --- --- Page 5 --- 🔹 4. AI + Backend Integration This is where you shine 🔥 Build: ● AI APIs in Laravel / Node ● Rate limiting ● Caching AI responses ● Async jobs ● Logging & monitoring 🔹 Phase 4: Real Projects (Non-Negotiable) You MUST build projects. Logs stored 🔹 Folder Structure (Laravel Example) app/ ├── AI/ │ ├── PromptBuilder.php │ ├── LLMClient.php │ ├── RAGService.php │ └── ResponseValidator.php ├── Jobs/ ├── Controllers/ 🎯 Final Reality Check After this plan, you can confidently say: ✅ “I am an AI Engineer” ✅ “I build AI-powered products” ✅ “I integrate LLMs into real systems” --- Page 21 --- Absolutely — here’s a complete, practical roadmap : 📍 Learn Python + FastAPI + AI engineering 📍 Build portfolio projects 📍 Find remote jobs globally 📍 Crack interviews for high-paying remote & FAANG roles (₹70 LPA+ / $60k+) I’ll break this into 5 sections with clear steps you can start following today. 🎯 1. Your Goal (Remote + FAANG + ₹70 LPA+) Remote and global opportunities pay significantly higher than local Indian offers (often $60–100k+ / equivalent ₹50–90 LPA+) especially in AI-focused roles. You’re aiming for either: ● Fully remote jobs ● Remote-friendly global companies ● FAANG (though many big FAANG teams require hybrid onsite at some stage) ( Reddit ) This means you must prepare not only technically but also for a global interview process. 🧱 2. Core Skill Path (Python + FastAPI + AI) 📌 Immediate Priorities A. Python Fundamentals ● Language basics (loops, functions, OOP) ● Intermediate: async, data modelling ● Modules: requests , logging , typing B. FastAPI ● Routing & APIs ● Request-response ● Dependency injection ● Authentication ● Async behaviours C. AI Engineering ● Calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure) --- Page 22 --- ● Embeddings + RAG systems ● Prompt engineering ● Building microservices for AI Focus : Build real code, not just read. 🛠 3. Project Roadmap (Portfolio Focus) Your goal is projects that prove capability to hiring managers: 🔹 Project 1 — AI Document Q&A ● Upload PDF / text corpora ● Build embeddings ● RAG + FastAPI endpoint ● Frontend React/Next for chat UI Skills Proven: Python, FastAPI, AI, RAG, database 🔹 Project 2 — AI Notes Summarizer (Healthcare focus optional) ● Upload medical notes ● Summaries & structured output (JSON) ● Suggest codes or insights Skills Proven: LLM handling, output engineering, error control 🔹 Project 3 — End-to-End Product Backend ● Multi-service architecture ● Auth (JWT) ● Logging, retries, cost control Skills Proven: Backend architecture + SaaS readiness --- Page 23 --- 💼 4. Remote Job Boards These list remote Python & AI roles globally. ● RemoteOK — Remote Python/AI listings (US & worldwide) ( Remote OK ) ● Arc.dev — Senior remote FastAPI & Python jobs (global) ( Arc ) ● CutShort — Remote Python jobs with filters ( Cutshort ) ● Instahyre — Remote FastAPI / backend listings ( Instahyre ) Set alerts on these platforms for keywords like: Python , FastAPI , AI Engineer , Machine Learning backend , Generative AI engineer . 🔹 2. Freelance & Marketplace (for early wins) ● Toptal — Top-tier remote contractor market (strict vetting but high pay) ( Wikipedia ) ● Andela Marketplace — Matches talent with global remote engagements ( Wikipedia ) These can give you high-paying contracts while you build towards full-time offers. 🔹 3. LinkedIn + GitHub ● Collect leads, connect with engineers and recruiters ● Publish projects with detailed READMEs ● Use keywords like FastAPI , Generative AI Backend , RAG Recruiters often search LinkedIn first. 🧠 5. Interview Prep Workflow 📌 Step 1 — Technical Fundamentals Focus on core competencies: ● Data Structures & Algorithms ● System design fundamentals --- Page 24 --- ● Python and service design FAANG-style interviews test these heavily — coding + design rounds. ( Interview Kickstart ) 📌 Step 2 — Remote Interview Practice Remote interviews are almost the same as onsite interviews: they include: ● Recruiter screens ● Coding challenges ● System design / architecture rounds ● Behavioral rounds ( We Work Remotely ) 📌 Step 3 — Mock Interviews Platforms for practice: ● LeetCode (Coding) ● HackerRank (Coding + assignments) ● Interview Kickstart style study scripts (system design & interview patterns) ( Interview Kickstart ) 📌 Step 4 — Portfolio + Resume Sync Your resume must NOT read like a standard Laravel resume. Instead: ✅ Highlight backend + FastAPI experience ✅ Show real AI project links (GitHub live links) ✅ Mention specific AI problems solved (RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering) Recruiters want to see demonstrable skills before interviews .
